tier: Tier T2 Verified Fixture & Structural Coordinate Benchmark
grounding_note: Evaluates 17 recorded ClinVar variation records (across 9 distinct CFTR protein changes) and MyVariant.info annotations against UniProt P13569 / RefSeq NM_000492.4 / Cryo-EM (PDB 5UAK, 6MSM, 8EIQ) structural domain coordinates. No synthetic scores or unverified LoRA weights are used; every missing annotation is explicitly recorded as 'not stated'.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: Sequence conservation vs. structural benignity split on Lasso-motif VUS R31L (VCV000054087): CADD Phred is 22.9 (top <1% conserved, GERP++ RS=437.4), whereas PolyPhen-2 (0.131, benign) and SIFT (0.13, tolerated) classify p.Arg31Leu as benign, matching ClinVar expert panel 'Uncertain significance'.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: Codon degeneracy & review-tier asymmetry across identical protein changes: N1303K (NBD2), Y1092* (TMD2), W1282* (NBD2), and F508del (NBD1) each map to multiple ClinVar Variation IDs with distinct cDNA changes and review statuses (e.g., N1303K c.3909C>G [uid 7136, practice guideline, 52 SCVs] vs. c.3909C>A [uid 4818550, single submitter, 1 SCV]). Protein-only predictors score both identically, masking clinical evidence depth.

key_benchmark_findings.label: [observed]
key_benchmark_findings.summary: ClinVar 'drug response' classification on TMD2 pore/hinge missense variant D1152H (VCV000035867, review_status: reviewed by expert panel, trait: 'ivacaftor response - Efficacy'): binary pathogenic/benign classifiers misrepresent pharmacogenomic residual-function variants without a separate modulator-response label.
